Application Data.NAME: Art Haven Gallery
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Jane Smith, Gallery Manager, 123 Art Street, Suite 200, Boston, MA 02118-1234, (555) 123-4567, jane.smith@arthaven.com
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Art Haven Gallery specializes in showcasing and selling contemporary and classic artworks from both established and emerging artists. We offer a diverse range of art pieces, including paintings, sculptures, and photography, while also providing a selection of high-quality art supplies for both amateur and professional artists. Our gallery hosts regular exhibitions and art events, fostering a vibrant community of art enthusiasts and creators. We maintain robust data security measures for our online sales platform to protect customer information and transactions. Additionally, we ensure that our gallery's climate control systems are regularly serviced to safeguard the integrity of the artworks on display.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 10, 2022, a ransomware attack targeted our online sales platform, compromising customer data and resulting in a loss of $10,000 for recovery and mitigation efforts. The incident was reported to law enforcement, and we have since implemented enhanced cybersecurity measures. Additionally, on August 15, 2022, our HVAC system failed during a heatwave, resulting in $5,000 in damages due to overheating sensitive artworks. Both incidents are now resolved, with improved protocols in place to prevent future occurrences.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, UL Listed, Grade A
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security guard patrols during business hours, motion detector alarms, and monitored CCTV surveillance system for enhanced protection of artworks and supplies.
